claim.quote: By comparing this model to the results of the commissioning and production runs conducted prior to crystal growth, the distribution coefficients were determined for various impurities, contained in the powder at the parts-per-billion (ppb) level.

name: Application of zone refining to the development of NaI(Tl) detectors for SABRE North

summary.plain: SABRE North purifies its sodium-iodide powder by zone refining before growing crystals; this paper models the process and measures how well different impurities are removed.
summary.technical: Mathematical model of NaI zone refining fitted to commissioning and production runs; distribution coefficients of ppb-level impurities, used to predict the background of the SABRE North detectors in the region of interest.

title: Application of zone refining to the development of NaI(Tl) detectors for SABRE North
why_it_matters: Describes the purification step on which SABRE North's crystal production for the physics detector rests.
